Contributors: Hains, Peter C.; Houston, D. C. (David Crawford), 1835-1893

Map indicates fortifications, drainage, hachures, vegetation, roads, and houses. Positions of Confederate batteries are shown with the number of guns in each. Inset contains a keyed list of the Union batteries giving the number and type of guns in each position, and the names of the battery commanders.
